title.zh: 将南拉瑙省巴拉巴甘市镇巴纳戈小学的名称变更为巴拉巴甘小学社区学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Banago Elementary School in the Municipality of Balabagan, Province of Lanao del Sur, to Balabagan Elementary Community School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Banago Elementary School in the Municipality of Balabagan, Province of Lanao del Sur, to Balabagan Elementary Community School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Banago tại Thị trấn Balabagan, Tỉnh Lanao del Sur thành Balabagan Elementary Community School
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Banago ในเทศบาล Balabagan, จังหวัด Lanao del Sur เป็น Balabagan Elementary Community School
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Banago di Kotamadya Balabagan, Provinsi Lanao del Sur menjadi Balabagan Elementary Community School
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Banago di Perbandaran Balabagan, Wilayah Lanao del Sur menjadi Balabagan Elementary Community School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1967/ra_4895_1967.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Banago Elementary School in the Municipality of Balabagan, Province of Lanao del Sur, is hereby changed to Balabagan Elementary Community School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1967.
